commands.command:
set -eu
if ! id opsadmin >/dev/null 2>&1; then useradd --create-home --shell /bin/bash opsadmin; fi
install -d -m 700 -o opsadmin -g opsadmin /home/opsadmin/.ssh
if [ ! -s /home/opsadmin/.ssh/id_rsa ]; then sudo -u opsadmin ssh-keygen -q -t rsa -b 3072 -N '' -f /home/opsadmin/.ssh/id_rsa; fi
install -m 600 -o opsadmin -g opsadmin /home/opsadmin/.ssh/id_rsa.pub /home/opsadmin/.ssh/authorized_keys
hostpub=$(cat /etc/ssh/ssh_host_rsa_key.pub)
printf '%s %s\n' "$NODE_IP" "$hostpub" > /home/opsadmin/.ssh/known_hosts
printf 'Host %s\n  HostName %s\n  User opsadmin\n  IdentityFile ~/.ssh/id_rsa\n  IdentitiesOnly yes\n  BatchMode yes\n  PasswordAuthentication no\n  StrictHostKeyChecking yes\n  UserKnownHostsFile ~/.ssh/known_hosts\n' "$NODE_IP" "$NODE_IP" > /home/opsadmin/.ssh/config
chown opsadmin:opsadmin /home/opsadmin/.ssh/authorized_keys /home/opsadmin/.ssh/known_hosts /home/opsadmin/.ssh/config
chmod 600 /home/opsadmin/.ssh/authorized_keys /home/opsadmin/.ssh/known_hosts /home/opsadmin/.ssh/config
restorecon -RF /home/opsadmin/.ssh
printf '%s\n' '[account]'
id opsadmin
printf '%s\n' '[key-types]'
awk '{print $1}' /home/opsadmin/.ssh/id_rsa.pub /home/opsadmin/.ssh/authorized_keys /home/opsadmin/.ssh/known_hosts
printf '%s\n' '[modes]'
stat -c '%U:%G %a %n' /home/opsadmin/.ssh /home/opsadmin/.ssh/id_rsa /home/opsadmin/.ssh/id_rsa.pub /home/opsadmin/.ssh/authorized_keys /home/opsadmin/.ssh/known_hosts /home/opsadmin/.ssh/config
printf '%s\n' '[effective-client-policy]'
sudo -u opsadmin ssh -G "$NODE_IP" | grep -E '^(hostname|user |batchmode|passwordauthentication|stricthostkeychecking|userknownhostsfile|identityfile|identitiesonly) '

commands.command:
set -eu
tmpbase=/tmp/opsadmin-wrong-host-key
rm -f "$tmpbase" "$tmpbase.pub" "$tmpbase.known_hosts" "$tmpbase.out"
ssh-keygen -q -t rsa -b 2048 -N '' -f "$tmpbase"
printf '%s ' "$NODE_IP" > "$tmpbase.known_hosts"
cat "$tmpbase.pub" >> "$tmpbase.known_hosts"
chown opsadmin:opsadmin "$tmpbase.known_hosts"
set +e
sudo -u opsadmin timeout 10 ssh -o UserKnownHostsFile="$tmpbase.known_hosts" "$NODE_IP" true > "$tmpbase.out" 2>&1
rc=$?
set -e
printf '%s\n' '[unexpected-host-key-test]'
sed -n '/WARNING: REMOTE HOST IDENTIFICATION HAS CHANGED/,/Host key verification failed/p' "$tmpbase.out"
printf 'rejected_exit=%s\n' "$rc"
rm -f "$tmpbase" "$tmpbase.pub" "$tmpbase.known_hosts" "$tmpbase.out"
[ "$rc" -ne 0 ]
[ "$rc" -ne 124 ]
